        01
        

          Personal details
          
Who you're reading about.

        

      


      

        

        

          

            I'm in my first year of the Cybersecurity & Digital Forensics diploma at Temasek Polytechnic.
          

          

            My modules so far are Ethical Hacking, Forensics in Digital Security, and Server Administration and Security. Almost all of it is hands-on, which is where the Unix/Linux and Windows Server work, the reading on how attacks get in, and the packet-capture digging come from.
          

          

            Before poly I finished my O-Levels at Pasir Ris Secondary School with seven credits and distinctions in Additional Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Humanities and Mathematics. The maths and science side of that has carried over into the networking and forensics modules.

        04
        

          Projects
          
Things I actually finished.

          
Four things I built because something annoyed me enough to fix it: adoption listings for a shelter, an assistant that works with no network, and both halves of a bus-timing idea.

        

      


      
      


        

          
          

            

              01
              Web app
            

            
Pet adoption website

            
Design + build · solo

            

              An adoption platform where shelters list animals and visitors browse them. Every listing carries a live status, available or reserved, alongside breed, species, age and sex.
            

            

              
              Public listings and an admin login that keeps the catalogue with shelter staff rather than the public.
            

          

        


        

          
          

            

              02
              Android
            

            
Offline AI assistant

            
Design + build · solo

            

              An assistant that runs a Gemma 4 E2B model on the phone itself through LiteRT. It handles scheduling, notes, metrics and music, and takes new abilities through a /skill command surface without the model itself changing.
            

            

              
              No network connection and no cloud round-trip. The model runs on the device.
            

          

        


        

          
          

            

              03
              Android
            

            
Bus arrival companion

            
Design + build · solo

            

              A Singapore bus app that ranks nearby stops by walking distance and resolves each one against the road it sits on. Search works by stop or road, and a toggle moves between stops and the services calling at them.
            

            

              
              Favourites pin the commute you actually do, with a trains view alongside.
            

          

        


        

          
          

            

              04
              In progress
            

            
Bus timing keychain

            
In progress · hardware

            

              The hardware half of the bus project: a Cheap Yellow Display (ESP32) built toward keychain size and paired to the phone, so live timings sit on a screen you clip to a bag instead of opening an app.
            

            

              
              Firmware and enclosure are still being worked out. Not finished yet.

        06
        

          Strengths
          
How I work.

          
How I tend to work, in four lines.

        

      


      

        

          01
          
Documents things others can act on

          
Notes system configurations and incident findings so the next person can pick it up without asking me a single question.

        

        

          02
          
Policy-aware by default

          
Applies IT security policies and access-control requirements while handling accounts. The policy part comes first, not after the work is done.

        

        

          03
          
Turns a fault into a test

          
Works a fault down in steps, which cuts repeat faults and gets to the fix sooner. Fixing the symptom and moving on is the thing I try not to do.

        

        

          04
          
Patient with non-technical people

          
Explains technical issues over phone and email in plain language, and stays professional when the question is a repeat.
